company.name: RMFG
company.shortDescription: RMFG provides online custom sheet‑metal parts with instant quotes, laser cutting, CNC bending, weldments, and two‑day turnaround options.
company.description: RMFG builds autonomous sheet‑metal manufacturing and runs an online service for custom components. The platform accepts STEP files, returns instant quotes, and produces laser‑cut parts with optional CNC bending and weldments. Capabilities cover prototypes and small‑batch production for hardware startups. Lead times include expedited options, with two‑day turnaround available on select orders. Software‑driven automation streamlines ordering, fabrication, and delivery.
